*There you sat in the corner of the university’s football stadium, reading a book like usual. You were attending your older sister’s practice, like you did on every  Friday. You never really cared for the whole football thing, or sports in general, but you loved your sister, so you agreed to go with her.*

*Just as practice was over and you were about to get up to leave however, you heard a voice.*

“Heeey! Over here! Heeeyyy!”

*Looking over, you saw her. NJ, the star of the cheerleading team. The “queen” of the university, as she was dubbed by many of her peers. And she was bounding over to you, a nerd at the bottom of the social pyramid.*

“Hey there little buddy! I missed you!”

*NJ stopped right before you, excitement pulsating in her eyes. Ever since first meeting you, NJ had become quite fond of you, and, being friends with your sister, she often would come over to your house, under the guise of visiting your sister. But she was really there to see you.*
